stages.name: yama
stages.description: Non-harming, truthfulness, non-stealing, continence, non-possessiveness; the great vow when unlimited; signs of establishment (YS 2.30–2.39).

stages.name: niyama
stages.description: Purity, contentment, austerity, self-study, devotion to Īśvara (YS 2.32), with their signs (2.40–2.45).

stages.name: āsana
stages.description: Steady and comfortable; by relaxing effort and coalescence with the endless; no assault by the pairs of opposites (YS 2.46–2.48).

stages.name: prāṇāyāma
stages.description: Cutting off the course of inhalation and exhalation (YS 2.49–2.51); summary only; result: the covering of the light dwindles, the mind is fit for concentration (2.52–2.53).

stages.name: pratyāhāra
stages.description: The senses' seeming imitation of the mind's form when not in contact with their objects; supreme mastery of the senses (YS 2.54–2.55).

stages.name: dhāraṇā
stages.description: Named in YS 2.29; taught in pāda 3 (outside this chunk).

stages.name: dhyāna
stages.description: Named in YS 2.29; taught in pāda 3 (outside this chunk).

stages.name: samādhi
stages.description: Named in YS 2.29; taught in pāda 3 (outside this chunk).

name: The five means of YS 1.20 as a sequence (YBh 1.20)

stages.name: śraddhā
stages.description: Serenity of the mind; like a kind mother it protects the yogin.

stages.name: vīrya
stages.description: Arises in one who has faith and seeks discernment.

stages.name: smṛti
stages.description: Stands present in one in whom energy has arisen.

stages.name: samādhi
stages.description: The unagitated mind, mindfulness being present, is concentrated.

stages.name: prajñā
stages.description: In one whose mind is concentrated, the discernment of insight arises, by which he knows the thing as it is.

name: The sevenfold final insight (YS 2.27 with YBh)

stages.name: heya parijñāta
stages.gloss: what is to be abandoned is fully known
stages.description: Nothing more to be known.

stages.name: heya-hetu kṣīṇa
stages.description: Nothing more to wear away.

stages.name: hāna sākṣātkṛta
stages.description: By the samādhi of stilling (nirodha-samādhi).

stages.name: hānopāya bhāvita
stages.description: Discernment (viveka-khyāti).

stages.name: caritādhikārā buddhiḥ
stages.description: First of the three liberations of the mind.

stages.name: guṇāḥ pralayābhimukhāḥ
stages.description: Like boulders fallen from a mountain peak, without footing; they go to setting with the mind.

stages.name: nā punar utpādaḥ
stages.description: Once dissolved, for lack of purpose.

name: The ladder of samādhi in the Yoga Sūtra (samāpatti → viveka-khyāti → nirbīja → dharmamegha → kaivalya): the stages of pādas 1–2

stages.name: savitarka / nirvitarka
stages.description: Coalescence on a gross object (YS 1.42–1.43).

stages.name: savicāra / nirvicāra
stages.description: Coalescence on a subtle object; lucidity and inner clarity (YS 1.44, 1.47).

stages.name: prajñā-saṃskāra
stages.description: It obstructs other impressions (YS 1.50).

stages.name: viveka-khyāti
stages.description: The unwavering discernment (YS 2.26).
